title: AWKUM Students Participate in Indus Ras Expo 2026: Robotics and Autonomous Systems
text:
The Career Counseling and Placement
Center (CCPC) facilitated the participation of students from the Departments of
Computer Science and Physics at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM) in
the Indus Robotics and Autonomous Systems (RAS) Expo 2026, held at the
Pak-China Friendship Centre, Islamabad.

The two-day national expo,
organized by Ignite – National Technology Fund under the Ministry of
Information Technology and Telecommunication (MoITT), in collaboration with the
National Centre of Robotics and Automation (NCRA) and the NUST College of
Electrical and Mechanical Engineering (E&ME). brought together
universities, researchers, startups, industry leaders, policymakers, and
technology professionals from across Pakistan to showcase innovations in
robotics, artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, drone technology, and
industrial automation.

The students were accompanied by
the CCPC team, including the Director, Dr. Muhammad Bilal, and Assistant
Directors Usman Shamroz and Hazrat Bilal. During the visit, the students
explored cutting-edge technologies, interacted with researchers, entrepreneurs,
and industry experts, and gained valuable insights into the latest developments
in robotics and artificial intelligence. The visit provided an excellent
platform for networking, knowledge exchange, and fostering stronger
industry–academia collaboration. It also reflected the vision of the Vice
Chancellor, Prof. Dr. Jamil Ahmad, to equip students with the knowledge,
skills, and professional competencies required to excel in an increasingly
technology-driven and globally interconnected world, thereby enhancing their
career readiness and future employability.
